title: Projects on agrmohit.com
description: Read by tools/build.ts, which checks the same rules in tools/manifest.ts.

projects.description: In the order the home page lists them.

tag.description: Build the page from the README at this tag: letters, digits and . _ + - (no ..).

commit.description: Build the page from the README at this full commit SHA.

readme.description: A local README, relative to tools/, while a page is being written. Builds only with --out DIR.

page.description: false: list the project without a page.

path.description: A page this repo already holds; only its card and sitemap entry are built.

slug.description: The page's folder under /projects/. Defaults to the repo's name.

title.description: The name in the projects list.

blurb.description: HTML for the projects list; as plain text, the page's description and the card's subtitle.

license.description: SPDX id, shown in the list.

card.description: false: no card. An object overrides the card's text.

title.description: Defaults to the README's first heading.

subtitle.description: Defaults to the blurb as plain text; a newline breaks the line.

drop.description: README page only: headings of sections to leave out, each with everything under it. A name no heading has fails the build. Sections left empty (a chart hosted elsewhere) go anyway.

sitemap.description: Defaults to true for a project with a page.

list.description: Defaults to true: show it in the home page's projects list.
